newsitem.title: INDIA: India approves RPG Telephone's joint venture.
newsitem.headline: India approves RPG Telephone's joint venture.

text.p: The Indian Industry Ministry on Thursday approved RPG Telephone Ltd's proposal to set up a joint venture with foreign equity of five billion rupees ($140 million).
The ministry said in a statement that the joint venture, with a foreign equity holding of 48 percent, would make investments in infrastructure and telecommunications sector.
It provided no other details nor did it give the name of the foreign investor.
